title: metaspec-kpis/1
description: A KPI catalogue with neutral field names: `measure` for the measure kind and `modes` for a direction per mode. Two producers, both metaspec: its own catalogue `kpis/catalogue.yaml` (rows as a pack writes them, `modes` a map from a mode to its direction, `gate` absent where no threshold is set), and the KpiCatalogue data of a generated KPI page (a pack's catalogue read through its manifest: `measure` and `modes` at the top name the pack's own columns, `modes` of a row is a list, the pack's other columns are in `extra`, and the page adds `layer`, `planned` and `route`). A pack's words for the values (a measure kind, a direction, a status) are kept as data; metaspec's own catalogue writes `direction` as `higher_is_better` or `lower_is_better`.

measure.description: The pack's name of the column that holds the measure kind (its manifest's `kpis.fields.measure`). Absent: `measure`.

modes.description: The pack's name of the column that holds a direction per mode (its manifest's `kpis.fields.modes`). Absent: `modes`.

block.description: The block the KPI belongs to, as written; a block the pack does not have is planned.

measure.description: The measure kind, in the pack's words.

direction.description: Which way the value is better, in the pack's words.

modes.description: A direction per mode; may be empty.

gate.description: Whether the KPI gates; absent: it does not.

reads.description: The events of the blocks the KPI reads.

status.description: The row's status, in the pack's words.

extra.description: The pack's other columns, as text.

layer.description: On a KPI page: the layer number of the block, null for a planned block.

planned.description: On a KPI page: the block is planned.

route.description: On a KPI page: the address of the block's KPIs.
